purpose: Fresh checkout can generate and install a new four-rack BMC, PostgreSQL, LDAP and DPS/PRS instance without copying an existing identity.

artifact_acquisition.chart: Official NGC download from an initially empty package directory; version and pinned SHA256 verified
artifact_acquisition.ldap_build: Pinned Debian base and verified packages; network disabled during build
artifact_acquisition.image_download_scope: Matching Docker digest cache was reused; this run does not claim all image layers were freshly pulled

generated_identity.certificate_authorities: New per-instance DPS, PostgreSQL, LDAP and BMC CA/private key pairs
generated_identity.tls: New server, Agent/client and ingress certificates; strict external TLS verification

scope.project_identity_and_application_data: Fresh; no old password, CA, JWT, Secret or database copied
scope.kubernetes: Explicit reuse of existing physical single-node native K3s
scope.native_first_install_review: Generated YAML parsed as a mapping and matched the rendered installer preflight exactly; nested kubeconfig script relocated; first installation was not executed on a separate blank OS.
scope.ui: Actual HTTPS session APIs; no visual browser acceptance
scope.bmc_authentication: Upstream simulator accepts supplied credentials but does not enforce password checks
scope.bmc_internal_tls: Private mock backend generates its own certificate; nginx internal verify is off; external CA verification is strict

history.initial_bmc_backend_tls: Unsupported external backend certificate mount removed; internal auto-generated certificate handled behind trusted external TLS
history.initial_ui_verifier: Missing /api prefix corrected; targeted UI recheck passed; first check history retained privately

detailed_evidence: Untracked verification reports/logs/archive on L20-12; runtime private identities and downloaded packages excluded from Git
